During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Blockade of Gobindi|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gobindi]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], four members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who were trapped on the planet maintained a '''safehouse'''. After [[Unidentified Human Rebel|one of the Rebels]] fell ill after being attacked by a [[blob]] creature, two other Rebels, [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and a [[Unidentified Bothan Rebel|Bothan]], carried their sick comrade back to the safehouse.
